- Cloud-native mastery: deep knowledge of cloud-native architecture, MLOps, infrastructure as code, and observability stacks — with specific experience on SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, or Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) strongly valued.
- AI & agentic systems: hands-on experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent system design.
- Mentorship & governance: proven ability to mentor senior engineers, enforce architectural guardrails, and drive consistent adoption of CI/CD and responsible AI practices across teams.
- Communication: ability to articulate architectural decisions clearly to engineers, product managers, and C-level stakeholders alike.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the EuroDrone Plateau, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Digitalization Officer for Programme Management

You are a full-time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Project Manager (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at the EuroDrone Plateau as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ingolstadt
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 1 year with possible prolongation

You have a unique chance to participate, learn and grow in the full development cycle of European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS), aka Eurodrone.

The Eurodrone Program, which is led by Airbus as Prime Contractor in front of the customer (OCCAR: Organisation Conjointe de Coopération en matière d’Armement) and accounts several sub-contractors and suppliers across Europe, is organized in multi-disciplinary Delivery Teams (DTs) ensuring a cross-national, cross-company multi-functional integration and delivery of sub-products. In the specific case of this position, the focus will be primarily on the core business of the MAGiCS Team e.g. the operational components of Eurodrone: Mission, Armament, Ground Control Station, Human Machine Interface and Human Factors Engineering. Efficiency of the development cycle is supported by a plateau located in Ingolstadt (Manching site) where all key actors are cooperating under one roof.

We are seeking a highly motivated working student to join our team of DT MAGiCS as a Digitalization Officer for Programme Management. As the Digitalization Officer for Programme Management, you will be responsible for digitalizing the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint. This includes setting up workflows,creating and assigning tasks, tracking progress, and mastering the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira. You will work closely with the project manager and the rest of the project team to ensure that the project is delivered on time, on cost, and on quality.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our daily business.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Digitalize the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and identify potential improvement areas.
- Set up workflows, create and assign tasks, and track progress using Jira.
- Master the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira.
- Support the Delivery Team Lead and the project managers as needed in project tracking.
- Contribute in reporting activities to make them leaner and more valuable.
- Participate and contribute to Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) routines as Program Increments (PI) planning, Product Owners sync, Systems Demos, Weekly/Daily stand-ups, Retrospectives, etc.
